messages:
Priya: Quick proposal for DP feedback sampling + priority matrix — want a fast thumbs so we can start outreach.
Cameron: Can you drop the sampling sheet link? :eyes:
Priya: https://redwood-internal/notes/dp-sampling-v2 (draft). TL;DR: target 4 workload buckets, quota-based recruitment, layered feedback cadence.
Jamie: What are the 4 buckets? simple list pls.
Priya: Low-latency interactive, high-throughput embeddings, long-context summarization, regulated/on-prem deployments.
Ana: Suggest numbers: 6 partners per bucket (24 total). Gives decent signal without huge ops overhead.
Mike: Ops constraint: legal + infra prep usually 2–3 weeks for private/on-prem partners. Need to factor into timeline.
Priya: Acceptance criteria for a partner to count as "ready":
- Integration completed within 5 working days
- 3 successful end-to-end runs for their primary workload
- No P0/P1 issues in those runs
- Completed short feedback form after each run
Cameron: Feedback loop proposal: weekly 10-min pulse (yes/no + top 1 thing) + biweekly 45-min deep dive for each bucket. Plus automated telemetry export.
Jamie: For prioritization, let's score issues by: severity(40), frequency(30), customer-value(30). Build a cutoff to escalate to the roadmap.
Ana: Agree. Also recommend a separate bucket for "integration pain" signals (onboarding friction) so we don't conflate infra bugs with model quality.
Priya: Proposed rollout gating: if >=70% of partners in a bucket report no critical regressions and onboarding median <= 3 days, we greenlight wider rollout for that workload.
Mike: Budget note: heavy long-context runs need Dedicated capacity reserve. Estimate ~150 GPU-hours across cohort — can we commit?
Priya: We can request a short reserve; I'll raise with infra. OpsBot will post a reservation request.
DeployBot: reservation_request_created: ticket #RD-4862 for 150 GPU-hours (pending approval).
Cameron: I'll take outreach + screening calls for the embeddings + interactive buckets.
Ana: I'll own the weekly pulse + synthesize the biweekly deep-dive notes into the priority matrix.
Jamie: I'll own the acceptance criteria tracking and the escalation playbook.
Priya: Can everyone who volunteered add availability for screening calls this week? I put a set of 30m slots on my calendar.
Cameron: Added.
Ana: Added. Will prepare the short feedback template and share by EOD.
Mike: I'll follow up on the GPU reserve request and legal checklist.
Priya: Thanks team — I'll update the sheet and post a short summary in #product after we lock the partner list. :thumbsup:
